description: Remediate DurisMUD persistence so 200 active players can be supported without lost updates, duplicate or lost critical state, or simulation-thread stalls from MySQL, Redis, filesystem, or fork-based persistence work.

1.name: Replace Forked Full Saves

2.name: Transactional Gameplay Domains
2.description: Move critical gameplay effects into operation-keyed transactions with ledgers, current state, revisions, and outbox publication.

0.name: Correctness and Immediate Lag Removal
